Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)

parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)

sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math
import random

# Main scene parameters, metres.
CAMERA_POSITION = (-1.20, -2.70, 2.00)
CAMERA_TARGET = (0.25, 0.00, 1.65)
CAMERA_LENS = 78
COUNTER_SIZE = (2.65, 0.83, 0.055)
CABINET_SIZE = (0.81, 0.37, 1.33)
ROLL_RADIUS = 0.112
ROLL_HEIGHT = 0.53
JUG_HEIGHT = 0.31
PITCHER_HEIGHT = 0.39

scene = Scene("Kitchen corner")
cream = (0.77, 0.71, 0.57)
doorcream = (0.83, 0.77, 0.64)
white = (0.88, 0.87, 0.80)
chrome = (0.52, 0.55, 0.53)
dark = (0.035, 0.043, 0.037)

def add(parent, name, node):
    parent.include(name, node)
    return node

def ring(parent, name, center, radius, tube, plane="xz", color=chrome, steps=24):
    pts = []
    for i in range(steps):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / steps
        if plane == "yz":
            p = (center[0], center[1]+radius*math.cos(a),
                 center[2]+radius*math.sin(a))
        elif plane == "xy":
            p = (center[0]+radius*math.cos(a),
                 center[1]+radius*math.sin(a), center[2])
        else:
            p = (center[0]+radius*math.cos(a), center[1],
                 center[2]+radius*math.sin(a))
        pts.append(p)
    for i in range(steps):
        add(parent, name+str(i), rod(radius=tube, start=pts[i],
            end=pts[(i+1) % steps], color=color))

architecture = Asset("Walls and counter")
add(architecture, "rear_wall",
    box((3.6, .08, 3.25), center=(.05,.39,1.62),
        color=(.70,.66,.53)))
add(architecture, "counter",
    box(COUNTER_SIZE, center=(.05,-.045,.89),
        color=(.31,.29,.23)))
add(architecture, "backsplash",
    box((2.65,.025,.16), center=(.05,.345,.995),
        color=(.32,.30,.24)))
scene.include("architecture", architecture)

# Recessed window, bright glass and regularly spaced Venetian blind slats.
window = Asset("Window and blinds")
add(window, "glass", box((1.04,.025,1.90),
    center=(-.52,.325,1.91), color=(.66,.81,.84)))
for x in (-1.065,.025):
    add(window, "jamb"+str(x), box((.055,.10,2.02),
        center=(x,.28,1.91), color=white))
add(window, "sill", box((1.15,.18,.055),
    center=(-.52,.24,.945), color=white))
add(window, "middle_sash", box((1.04,.055,.045),
    center=(-.52,.265,1.86), color=white))
add(window, "vertical_sash", box((.032,.045,1.9),
    center=(-.65,.27,1.91), color=white))
for i in range(34):
    z = .985 + i*.054
    slat = box((1.075,.065,.012),
        center=(-.52,.195,z), color=(.86,.86,.78))
    slat.turn(axis="+x", degrees=-12)
    add(window, "slat_%02d" % i, slat)
for i,x in enumerate((-.87,-.25)):
    add(window, "blind_tape_%d" % i, box((.012,.008,1.85),
        center=(x,.155,1.91), color=(.75,.75,.66)))
add(window, "pull_cord", rod(radius=.002,
    start=(-.13,.13,2.48), end=(-.13,.13,1.84),
    color=(.79,.77,.66)))
add(window, "cord_end", rod(radius=.009, length=.045,
    center=(-.13,.13,1.83), color=(.77,.69,.49)))
scene.include("window", window)

cabinet = Asset("Cream upper cabinet")
add(cabinet, "carcase", box(CABINET_SIZE,
    center=(.58,.145,2.205), color=cream))
# Front frame projects slightly beyond the door.
add(cabinet, "door", box((.715,.035,1.24),
    center=(.605,-.058,2.225), color=doorcream))
add(cabinet, "inset_panel", box((.575,.012,1.08),
    center=(.605,-.080,2.235), color=(.79,.73,.60)))
for i,x in enumerate((.282,.928)):
    add(cabinet, "door_stile_%d" % i, box((.037,.024,1.20),
        center=(x,-.09,2.225), color=doorcream))
for i,z in enumerate((1.635,2.815)):
    add(cabinet, "door_rail_%d" % i, box((.66,.024,.045),
        center=(.605,-.09,z), color=doorcream))
add(cabinet, "knob_stem", rod(radius=.009,
    start=(.947,-.105,1.845), end=(.947,-.137,1.845),
    color=(.40,.35,.23)))
add(cabinet, "knob", ball(.018, center=(.947,-.145,1.845),
    color=(.47,.42,.28)))
scene.include("cabinet", cabinet)

paper = Asset("Mounted paper towel roll")
rollx, rolly, rollz = .735, -.228, 2.10
add(paper, "paper", rod(radius=ROLL_RADIUS, length=ROLL_HEIGHT,
    center=(rollx,rolly,rollz), color=(.94,.91,.81)))
add(paper, "loose_sheet", box((.148,.006,.505),
    center=(rollx-.014,rolly-.105,rollz-.007),
    color=(.94,.91,.82)))
for i,z in enumerate((rollz-.294,rollz+.294)):
    add(paper, "axle_%d" % i, rod(radius=.017, length=.06,
        center=(rollx,rolly,z), color=(.36,.35,.29)))
    add(paper, "wall_arm_%d" % i, rod(radius=.018,
        start=(rollx,-.09,z), end=(rollx,rolly,z),
        color=(.34,.34,.29)))
add(paper, "top_finial", ball(.025,
    center=(rollx,rolly,rollz+.315), color=chrome))
scene.include("paper", paper)

towel = Asset("Ring and hanging towel")
# Ring attached to the visible left cabinet side.
add(towel, "mount", rod(radius=.035,
    start=(.145,.075,1.925), end=(.187,.075,1.925),
    color=chrome))
add(towel, "mount_neck", rod(radius=.012,
    start=(.145,.075,1.925), end=(.112,.025,1.925),
    color=chrome))
ring(towel, "ring_", (.110,-.018,1.815), .113, .006, "yz")
# Narrow overlapping vertical strips give the cloth a soft, folded silhouette.
for i in range(9):
    t = i/8
    x = .032 + .026*i
    bottom = 1.065 + .045*math.cos(t*math.pi*2) + .035*t
    top = 1.735 - .045*abs(t-.42)
    y = -.135 + .022*math.sin(t*math.pi*3)
    add(towel, "cloth_fold_%d" % i,
        box((.031,.022,top-bottom),
            center=(x,y,(top+bottom)/2),
            color=(.88+.025*math.sin(i),.86+.025*math.sin(i),.77)))
# A second layer falls behind the front folds.
backcloth = box((.13,.025,.38),
    center=(.235,-.045,1.45), color=(.80,.77,.66))
backcloth.turn(axis="+y", degrees=-18)
add(towel, "rear_drape", backcloth)
scene.include("towel", towel)

# Sink opening with a narrow metal rim; foreground is intentionally cropped.
sink = Asset("Sink and faucet")
add(sink, "rim", box((.66,.48,.018),
    center=(-.64,-.415,.925), color=(.38,.40,.35)))
add(sink, "basin_dark", box((.58,.405,.023),
    center=(-.64,-.43,.928), color=(.065,.075,.060)))
add(sink, "inner_bottom", box((.46,.31,.014),
    center=(-.64,-.43,.936), color=(.09,.105,.08)))
add(sink, "faucet_base", rod(radius=.04, length=.023,
    center=(-.56,-.185,.94), color=chrome))
add(sink, "faucet_stem", rod(radius=.013,
    start=(-.56,-.185,.95), end=(-.56,-.185,1.205),
    color=chrome))
add(sink, "faucet_top", rod(radius=.013,
    start=(-.56,-.185,1.205), end=(-.56,-.255,1.235),
    color=chrome))
add(sink, "spout", rod(radius=.012,
    start=(-.56,-.255,1.235), end=(-.56,-.315,1.205),
    color=chrome))
for i,x in enumerate((-.67,-.44)):
    add(sink, "tap_base%d"%i, rod(radius=.026,length=.018,
        center=(x,-.19,.946),color=chrome))
    add(sink, "tap_handle%d"%i, rod(radius=.009,
        start=(x,-.19,.956),end=(x+.032,-.18,.986),
        color=chrome))
add(sink, "soap_dish", box((.13,.10,.025),
    center=(-.89,-.22,.944), color=(.59,.57,.43)))
add(sink, "soap", box((.09,.065,.023),
    center=(-.89,-.22,.969), color=(.82,.79,.64)))
scene.include("sink", sink)

blender = Asset("Blender and small canister")
add(blender,"motor",rod(radius=.077,length=.19,
    center=(.36,.018,1.02),color=(.035,.043,.038)))
add(blender,"motor_top",rod(radius=.080,length=.022,
    center=(.36,.018,1.12),color=(.10,.105,.085)))
cup=rod(radius=.060,length=.205,
    center=(.36,.018,1.23),color=(.48,.51,.44),opacity=.30)
cup.turn(axis="+y",degrees=-9)
add(blender,"clear_cup",cup)
ring(blender,"cup_rim_",(.344,.018,1.332),.059,.004,"xy",
     color=(.63,.64,.54),steps=16)
add(blender,"can",rod(radius=.043,length=.18,
    center=(.18,.055,1.005),color=(.32,.37,.20)))
add(blender,"can_lid",rod(radius=.045,length=.012,
    center=(.18,.055,1.10),color=(.59,.57,.39)))
add(blender,"small_bottle",rod(radius=.020,length=.095,
    center=(.205,-.08,.982),color=(.45,.46,.32)))
scene.include("blender",blender)

# Gallon jug: broad body, tapered shoulder, cap and a separate handle.
jug = Asset("Translucent gallon jug")
jx,jy=.60,-.185
add(jug,"body",fillet_box((.235,.172,.225),radius=.044,
    center=(jx,jy,1.037),color=(.73,.75,.67),opacity=.87))
add(jug,"shoulder",ball(.105,center=(jx,jy,1.138),
    color=(.75,.77,.69),opacity=.87))
add(jug,"neck",rod(radius=.031,length=.062,
    center=(jx,jy,1.218),color=(.77,.78,.70),opacity=.88))
add(jug,"cap",rod(radius=.034,length=.025,
    center=(jx,jy,1.251),color=(.85,.84,.75)))
# Handle lies on the jug's visible right shoulder.
handlepts=[(jx+.060,jy-.002,1.174),
           (jx+.107,jy-.002,1.156),
           (jx+.112,jy-.002,1.111),
           (jx+.081,jy-.002,1.088)]
add(jug,"handle",sweep_tube(points=handlepts,radius=.014,
    color=(.78,.79,.71)))
scene.include("jug",jug)

pitcher = Asset("Blue water filter pitcher")
px,py=.91,.075
add(pitcher,"blue_body",fillet_box((.235,.18,.315),radius=.047,
    center=(px,py,1.077),color=(.032,.075,.16),opacity=.84))
add(pitcher,"water_lower",box((.18,.13,.105),
    center=(px,py,1.001),color=(.045,.11,.19),opacity=.65))
lid=fillet_box((.245,.19,.036),radius=.014,
    center=(px-.007,py,1.245),color=(.31,.33,.29))
lid.turn(axis="+y",degrees=9)
add(pitcher,"lid",lid)
add(pitcher,"spout",box((.058,.13,.042),
    center=(px-.123,py,1.232),color=(.32,.34,.30)))
handlepts=[(px+.107,py,1.22),(px+.170,py,1.193),
           (px+.196,py,1.105),(px+.178,py,1.008),
           (px+.116,py,.976)]
add(pitcher,"clear_handle",sweep_tube(points=handlepts,
    radius=.017,color=(.48,.51,.46)))
add(pitcher,"base_rim",box((.19,.15,.018),
    center=(px,py,.925),color=(.16,.19,.19)))
scene.include("pitcher",pitcher)

realize(scene)

# Procedural materials: fine granite flecks and paper/cloth surface variation.
def noise_material(name, colors, scale, roughness=.7, bump_strength=0):
    mat=bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes=True
    nodes=mat.node_tree.nodes
    links=mat.node_tree.links
    bs=nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=roughness
    tex=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=scale
    tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value=2.0
    ramp=nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.25
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(*colors[0],1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.77
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(*colors[1],1)
    links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs["Fac"])
    links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
    if bump_strength:
        bump=nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=bump_strength
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.002
        links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
        links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    return mat

granite=noise_material("Speckled warm granite",
    ((.075,.070,.055),(.56,.51,.40)),210,.64,.22)
paper_mat=noise_material("Subtle paper texture",
    ((.83,.80,.70),(.96,.93,.84)),145,.92,.08)

# Identify material targets by their positions and dimensions rather than mesh names.
for obj in list(bpy.context.scene.objects):
    if obj.type != 'MESH':
        continue
    center=obj.matrix_world.translation
    dims=obj.dimensions
    if dims.x>2.0 and center.z<1.2:
        obj.data.materials.clear()
        obj.data.materials.append(granite)
    elif abs(center.x-rollx)<.12 and abs(center.z-rollz)<.08:
        if dims.z>.45:
            obj.data.materials.clear()
            obj.data.materials.append(paper_mat)
    for mat in obj.data.materials:
        if mat and mat.use_nodes:
            bs=mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
            if bs:
                col=bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value
                if max(col[:3])-min(col[:3])<.08 and .3<col[0]<.65:
                    bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.70
                    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.26

# A small handwritten-style label on the jug.
font=bpy.data.curves.new("Filter label","FONT")
font.body="FILTER"
font.align_x="CENTER"
font.size=.027
font.extrude=.0001
label=bpy.data.objects.new("Jug label",font)
bpy.context.collection.objects.link(label)
label.location=(jx,jy-.088,1.001)
label.rotation_euler=(math.pi/2,0,0)
ink=bpy.data.materials.new("Muted label ink")
ink.diffuse_color=(.24,.26,.22,1)
font.materials.append(ink)

set_view(CAMERA_POSITION,CAMERA_TARGET,lens=CAMERA_LENS)
world=bpy.context.scene.world
if world is None:
    world=bpy.data.worlds.new("Kitchen daylight")
    bpy.context.scene.world=world
world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(.69,.73,.76,1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.38

area_emitter((-1.3,-.02,2.15),power=210,size=1.15,
             target=(.45,.05,1.3),color=(.83,.91,1.0))
area_emitter((-.25,-1.6,2.8),power=80,size=2.5,
             target=(.4,.0,1.6),color=(1.0,.83,.62))
bpy.context.scene.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
